data.gender_notes: Alissa is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Ἀλεξία (Alexia), meaning 'defender' or 'helper'. In Christian tradition, Alissa is associated with the Virgin Mary, symbolizing strength, kindness, and protection. The name Alissa carries the meaning “Noble, kind” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alissa usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alissa total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
